verdict.rationale: Every Greptile review comment carries a first-party "Fix with your Agent" button. It sends the issue, with file paths, line numbers and suggested code, to Claude Code, Codex, Conductor, Cursor or Devin, and a "Fix All" button sends every finding at once. That gives the agent-generated follow-up path in the story, launched directly from the PR. Supporting flows include MCP `/check-pr` and `/greploop` to apply fixes until all comments are resolved. Missing for 10: no evidence that Greptile itself commits a patch or one-click suggested change to the PR branch; fix execution depends on external agents, some of them local editor tools, so whether the developer truly stays in the PR is unclear; no hands-on or independent corroboration of the fix flow.
